AI-Native Engineering
Skill Understanding & Requirement Mapping
Show the mapping Requirement -> Skill -> Expected behavior -> Output for each of the three capabilities, and explain why each skill applies.

Metadata -> ingestion_metadata skill -> populate batch_id, source_file, ingestion_timestamp -> all Bronze rows carry lineage. Idempotency -> idempotency skill -> anti-join business keys -> duplicate redelivery adds no records. Schema drift -> schema_drift skill -> detect, log, reconcile new columns -> evolved customer output preserves source values.
AI-Native Engineering
Skill Modification & Improvement

Describe the gap you found in the original SKILL.md, the change you made, and why it improves the guidance. A small, well-reasoned improvement scores higher than a large rewrite that adds little value.

Original schema-drift guidance covered one additive column but did not state how to handle a second independent drift. I added rules to compare with the fully evolved Bronze schema, retain earlier added columns and values, and validate sequential additive drift. Batch 4 preserved loyalty_tier while adding marketing_opt_in.
AI-Native Engineering
Skill Creation & Reusability

Explain the new data_quality_validation skill you created for Batch 5, the capability gap it fills, and why the guidance is reusable beyond this assignment. For this assignment, creating the data quality validation skill is required.

Created data_quality_validation for row-level business-rule checks and quarantine. It separates valid and invalid rows, retains rejected source values and metadata, requires a rejection reason, and keeps the batch running. The approach is parameterized by business key and can support other required-field rules.
AI-Native Engineering
Skill-Driven AI Interaction & Implementation
Show how you used the skill (as revised) to brief an AI tool/assistant, the context and constraints you gave it, and how you reviewed and refined its output.

Skills were read before implementation and used as implementation constraints. The assistant-generated approach was reviewed for anti-join key handling, unionByName schema alignment, metadata timing, blank-key trimming, quarantine lineage, and retry behavior. Tests and persistent output read-backs were used to refine and verify the result.
AI-Native Engineering
Validation, Iteration & Feedback Loop
Show at least one Generate -> Test -> Identify Gap -> Improve Skill -> Regenerate -> Validate cycle, not just a final working result.

Cycle demonstrated: identify missing second-drift guidance -> modify schema_drift skill -> implement and test Batch 4 -> validate preserved columns. Then identify missing row-level validation capability -> create data_quality_validation skill -> implement split/quarantine -> run two focused tests and persistent Batch 5 read-back (3 Bronze, 2 quarantined).
Data Engineering
Data Ingestion & PySpark Implementation
Reference your Batch 1 ingestion code and confirm all five entities load correctly.

src.pipeline, ingest, metadata, idempotent_writer, and spark_session load all five Batch 1 CSV entities to one Parquet Bronze output per entity. Automated ingestion test validates output folders, baseline counts, source columns, and metadata.
Data Engineering
Idempotency Implementation
Provide evidence that the Batch 2 duplicate redelivery does not create duplicate records.

Batch 2 uses a left anti-join on order_id before append. Evidence and automated test show the three redelivered sales transactions create zero new Bronze records and the sales row count remains unchanged.
Data Engineering
Schema Drift Implementation
Provide evidence that the Batch 3 loyalty_tier column is detected, handled, and present in the output.

Batch 3 detects and logs loyalty_tier, aligns schemas with missing columns, and combines data with unionByName. Validation confirms the column exists, Batch 1 values are null, and Batch 3 values are preserved. Batch 4 then confirms loyalty_tier remains intact while marketing_opt_in is added.
Data Engineering
Ingestion Metadata Implementation
Provide evidence that batch_id, source_file and ingestion_timestamp are correctly populated for every record.

Metadata is attached immediately after each CSV read. Tests and output checks confirm every Bronze and quarantined row has non-null batch_id, source_file, and ingestion_timestamp, while original source columns remain unchanged.

Idempotency - duplicate batch redelivery
idempotency (original)
Duplicate redelivery could create repeated order_id values without a target-key check.
Used the provided anti-join guidance and implemented a left anti-join on order_id before append.
The generated implementation writes only unseen order IDs.
Batch 2 wrote 0 rows; sales transaction count was unchanged and no duplicate keys were found.
Schema drift - loyalty_tier column
schema_drift (original)
A later customer batch adds loyalty_tier to the baseline schema.
Used the provided comparison, logging, and union-by-name guidance for Batch 3.
The implementation detects and logs the column while retaining historical rows.
loyalty_tier exists after Batch 3; 80 earlier rows are null and 3 Batch 3 values are populated.
Ingestion metadata - batch_id / source_file / ingestion_timestamp
ingestion_metadata (original)
Bronze and quarantined records require source lineage.
Used the provided metadata guidance to attach batch_id, source_file, and ingestion_timestamp immediately after reading.
Both normal and quarantine paths retain non-null lineage fields.
Automated metadata tests pass; Batch 5 quarantine read-back has 0 rows with missing metadata.
Schema drift skill modification - unexpected column on an already-evolved schema (Batch 4)
schema_drift (modified)
Original guidance did not explicitly address a second drift against an already-evolved schema.
Added full evolved-schema comparison, preservation of earlier columns/values, and sequential-drift validation.
Batch 4 adds marketing_opt_in without losing Batch 3 loyalty_tier data.
Batch 4 test and persistent run preserve loyalty_tier and add marketing_opt_in.
Data quality validation - null customer_id (Batch 5)
data_quality_validation (new)
No existing skill covered row-level required-key validation and quarantine.
Created reusable null/empty/whitespace key validation, valid/quarantine split, rejection reason, lineage, retry, and validation guidance.
The implementation quarantines invalid rows rather than dropping them or failing the batch.
Batch 5: 5 read, 3 valid rows written, 2 quarantined with customer_id is null or blank; focused tests: 2 passed.
